name: set by build.mjs
description: Checks for WCAG 2.2 A and AA items that rule engines do not cover, run on the tab you choose. Assists a tester; makes no statement about conformance.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' blob:; connect-src http://localhost:* http://*.localhost:* http://127.0.0.1:* https:; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'
